title: kbingest map fails two tests on Windows: the worktree path is not masked in notes, and a symlink checked out as a file is read
goal: On Windows, MapCtx.note masks the worktree root however the path is spelled (slash or backslash, as given or resolved), and the map's file reader treats a path git stores as a symbolic link (mode 120000) as not a regular file even when core.symlinks=false checked it out as a plain file; test_kbingest_map_notes_are_capped and test_kbingest_map_symlink_is_not_followed pass on Windows and Linux, so the sync gate is green on Windows hosts again.
notes: The operator put it in SP-76inhw33 “Windows clone complete” so a Windows host fixes and verifies it; the code belongs to SP-fkyrld5h “Ingestion maps code natively”.
